title: fix(app-shell): bind current_user.positions into the client predicate scope; align role-gating examples (#1583 / ADR-0058)
body:
## What & why

Follow-up to #2562 / #2559, closing a dual-side inconsistency found while wrapping up #1583's role-gated option item.

**1. Client scope gap (the behavior fix).** The console forwarded only `id/name/email/role/roles/isPlatformAdmin` into the expression scope (`ExpressionProvider` → `current_user`), so a position-gated option predicate — `'admin' in current_user.positions`, the shape the framework rule-validator binds and enforces (EvalUser; framework#2915) — **faulted client-side and failed open**: the gated option stayed visible to everyone in the console and was only rejected by the server on submit. `AppContent` and `RecordFormPage` now forward `positions` (the auth payload already carries it, `auth-manager.ts` session user), so client hiding and the server verdict agree.

**2. Example-spelling sweep (the docs fix).** Every role-gating example used `current_user.roles` — a key the server **never binds**, so a predicate written that way is never enforced (server faults → fail-open). All authoring surfaces now teach the enforceable spelling `current_user.positions`, matching `@objectstack/spec`'s own `SelectOption.visibleWhen` example:

- `examples/schema-catalog/.../role-gated-options.json` (the copyable demo)
- `content/docs/fields/select.mdx` snippet
- `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` (what AI authoring copies)
- ADR-0058 example spellings (illustrations only — no decision change)
- TSDoc on `SelectOption.visibleWhen` (`@object-ui/types` ×2), evaluator header comments (`optionRules.ts`, `optionLint.ts`, `SelectField.tsx`)
- the three unit tests' predicates + mock scopes

## Verification

- `optionRules` / `optionLint` / `SelectField.cascade` / `useExpression`: **51/51**
- schema-catalog: **836/836** (incl. the `option-predicates` guard over the changed example)
- eslint on changed files: 0 errors
- changeset: patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`

## Notes

- Branch note: same task branch restarted from latest `main` after #2562's squash-merge; the old tip (`46e473f`, already in `main` as `3eff499`) is merged in additively, so files-changed shows only this fix.
- The docs-site demo renders with no `current_user` scope, so its display is unchanged (fail-open keeps the option visible there); the spelling change is about what readers copy into real objects.

Related: #1583, #2559, #2562, framework#3006, framework#2915, ADR-0058.
